messages:
marta: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for prod v2.14. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Holdpoints at 10%, 50%, 100%. Need capacity thumbs up for each region. Deploy window 02:00-06:00 UTC. @sre-oncall you good?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678901.000000] Started rollout v2.14 -> prod/us canary(10%)

ben: US canary started. smoke tests green. Observability looks normal. CPU spike to 62% on p3s for the first 3 minutes, then back to 30s.

olivia: Confirming reserve pool warmed in us-east-1, +2 nodes. Prefetch cache primed.

marta: Holding at 10% for 15m. If tail-latency < 250ms and error rate < 0.1% we go to 50%. Rolling health checks: `latency_99 < 350` `5xx_rate < 0.1`

sre-oncall: Oncall here. Logs look clean. No SLO alerts. Approve move to 50% in 10.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678931.000000] Promoting to prod/us 50%

carla: 50% ramp looks ok. AFS queues increased but within buffering limits. Recommend pinning model to 2.14-rc3 for EU to avoid kernel mismatch.

marta: Noted. EU will be pinned to 2.14-rc3 for first rollout. APAC we keep unpinned for now because of tokenization differences.

ben: APAC note: warm-pools in ap-northeast-1 need longer warmup (6m). We'll pre-warm during EU ramp.

olivia: Also enabling fallback policy: `route: eu -> fallback: us` for first 2 hours post-rollout

pm-jon: Any release notes changes? I'll add model pin and warm-pool note.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678945.000000] Completed prod/us 100%

marta: US green. Starting EU canary now. @sre-oncall please watch EU latency; we've seen multi-second tails on 8k seq.

sre-oncall: Watching. Set alerts at `p99>600` for EU.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678955.000000] Started prod/eu canary(10%) with pin 2.14-rc3

carla: EU canary shows 20% higher memory due to different kernel tuning. Scaling policy increased minimum pods by 1.

ben: We should guard against EU rate cap spikes. If tokens/sec > baseline*1.5, pause ramp and open rollback channel.

marta: Rollback criteria agreed: p99 latency > 800ms for 5m OR 5xx_rate >0.3% sustained 3m. If hit, pause and roll back EU to 2.13.

olivia: Noted. I'll add ephemeral metric dashboards and a shortlink: https://dash/release/2345678901

pm-jon: Release notes updated with region pin, APAC warmup, rollback criteria, and change window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678965.000000] EU promoted to 50%

sre-oncall: EU at 50% stable so far. No p99 breaches.

marta: Proceeding to 100% in EU after 20m. APAC pre-warm started (ap-northeast-1 and ap-southeast-1).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678975.000000] EU completed 100%

ben: APAC warm pools report: ap-northeast-1 +3 nodes, ap-southeast-1 +2 nodes. Coldstart failure rate dropped to 0.3% during soak.

carla: Reminder: APAC local disk kernel bug -> keep model unpinned and use quantized fallback to reduce memory pressure.

marta: Final note: we'll keep rollback window open for 3 hours post full rollout. Any objections?

pm-jon: :thumbsup: no objections from PM side.

sre-oncall: I'll stay on until +3h. Slack channel #eng-releases will be our coordination thread.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [2345678990.000000] Rollout completed across regions. Version: v2.14. Rollback window until +3h.
